answer: Neighbor quorum blocks fakes. A newcomer pays 45 for five endorsements from five neighbors, each at a different wharf locking 40. Endorsements enter the public nebula ledger; auditors cap each neighbor at three endorsements per epoch. A rented-neighbor ring curls into a tight spiral; auditors burn its bonds. A thousand fakes need 5,000 endorsements, pay 45,000, lock 200,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its share.
